result.topic_en: Algebraic identities: expressing a difference of fifth powers of sextic binomials as a sum of three fifth powers, a partial-fraction generating function with explicit coefficients and an associated cubic, a representation of x{(x+a)^3+(x+b)^3} as a sum of three fourth powers, and a parametric identity among fourth powers.

methods.what: Identity expressing a difference of two fifth powers of x^6+ax, x^6+bx as a sum of three fifth powers of x^5 plus constants
Generating-function (partial fraction) determination of A,B,C,p,q,r via a rational function with explicit coefficients
Explicit values of the coefficients alpha, beta, gamma, delta, epsilon, phi
Substitution reducing the denominator cubic to a simpler cubic in M
Representation of x{(x+a)^3+(x+b)^3} as a combination of three fourth powers with explicit A,B,C,p,q
Parametric polynomial identity among fourth powers (difference of two fourth powers equals combination of four fourth powers)

items.quote:
If $z=\frac{1}{N}$, $N=\frac12(a+b)+\frac12 M(a-b)$, then the equation
$1+\delta z+\varepsilon z^2+\phi z^3=0$
is equivalent to
$5(a+b)(M^3-M) = (a-b)(5M^2-1)$.
items.english: If z=1/N with N=(a+b)/2+M(a-b)/2, then the cubic 1+δz+εz²+φz³=0 is equivalent to 5(a+b)(M³−M)=(a−b)(5M²−1).
x{(x+a)³+(x+b)³} equals A(x+p)⁴+B(x+q)⁴+Cx⁴ with the stated values of p, q, A, B, C.
